name: Tato Farmer
oracle_text:
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you may get two rad counters.
{T}: Put target land card in a graveyard that was milled this turn onto the battlefield under your control tapped.
blocked_sentences: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you may get two rad counters.
{T}: Put target land card in a graveyard that was milled this turn onto the battlefield under your control tapped.

needs.what: rad as a player counter kind (a PlayerState field plus an entry in the player counter kinds, with the rule-725 rad trigger at the beginning of each player's precombat main phase: mill that many cards, lose 1 life and remove one rad counter per nonland card milled), and an op that gives a player N rad counters (e.g. an `add_rad` op shaped like add_poison/add_energy with `amount` and `player`, accepting the attack trigger's defending player)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: add_poison and add_energy are the only ops that put counters on a player and each is fixed to its own kind; add_counters acts on objects, not players; no rad counter kind or rad precombat-main trigger exists in the engine

needs.what: a per-turn record of which cards were put into a graveyard by milling this turn (any source, any player's mill), exposed as a spell filter key (e.g. `milled_this_turn: true` in `affects_spells`) that the `cast_from_graveyard` static can read, so 'once during each of your turns, you may cast a spell from among cards in your graveyard that were milled this turn' is `cast_from_graveyard` with `affects_player: "you"`, `max_per_turn: 1`, `condition: {is_your_turn: true}` and that filter; the same record would also serve Tato Farmer and The Master, Transcendent's 'card in a graveyard that was milled this turn' target selectors
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cast_from_graveyard's affects_spells only takes SPELL_FILTER_KEYS (types, colors, mana_value, ...), none of which reads how a card arrived in the graveyard; the mill op's `as` binding only records cards milled by that one resolution (Locke's 'milled this way' / grant_playable), not every card milled this turn by any source, and selector_keys has drawn_this_turn and entered_this_turn but no milled equivalent
